column1: # Rhyme test list. One case per line: query <TAB> word <TAB> expectation <TAB> note
# perfect     word is in the results and counts as a perfect rhyme
# rhymes      word is in the results (any strength)
# notperfect  word is not a perfect rhyme (missing, or near only)
# absent      word must not be in the results at all
# name        word is in the results and marked as a name
# notname     word is in the results and not marked as a name
# Stress: an unstressed ending is not a perfect rhyme for a stressed one
# The same word is not a rhyme
# Names are marked, normal words are not
